product.name: Aurelio SilkSmooth 3-in-1 Styling Kit
product.description: The Aurelio SilkSmooth 3-in-1 Styling Kit offers a versatile solution for everyday hair care. It combines a ceramic curling iron, a flat iron, and a heat‑protective spray in a single ergonomic handle. Adjustable temperature settings from 140°C to 230°C accommodate fine to thick hair, while a built‑in heat sensor prevents overheating. The detachable cord and travel lock make it convenient for on‑the‑go styling. Lightweight yet durable, the kit’s polished steel chassis and heat‑resistant silicone grips provide a comfortable grip for precise control. Ideal for creating curls, straightening, or adding shine, it delivers salon‑quality results in minutes.
